source: Florida Senate Local Funding Initiative Requests, Fiscal Year 2018-19 (flsenate.gov/Session/Appropriations/FY2018-19/LocalFundingRequests), every form filed by the members in this slice; each form PDF read Oct 25-26, 2026. Budget status: each form number looked up as '(Senate Form n)' / '(SF n)' in the enacted GAA (HB 5001, Ch. 2018-9) and in the governor's veto list.

budget.vetoNote: No veto list found: not on flgov.com, and the line-item veto message of this House-originated GAA is printed in the House Journal, not the Senate Journal. Vetoed status of these forms is unknown (needs-browser.md item 6).
